title: Benisseur - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Benisseur in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Shares the Ballet's profile, which makes it one of several enemies covered by a single Ice or Dark party setup.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toIce, Dark
ResistsEarth, Light
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneNone

Bring Ice, Dark damage. Earth, Light is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: How to Beat the Benisseur
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Ice, Dark is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It resists Earth, Light, so that damage is halved.
